newsitem.title: USA: Vitalink Pharmacy to list on NYSE.
newsitem.headline: Vitalink Pharmacy to list on NYSE.

text.p: Vitalink Pharmacy Services Inc said it expects its shares to be listed on the New York Stock Exchange effective February 13 under the symbol "VTK."

Gene Burleson, who will become chief executive officer of Vitalink following the merger with TeamCare, GranCare Inc's institutional pharmacy business, said the listing will provide the company with access to a larger universe of investors both domestically and internationally.

Following the merger, Vitalink will provide medication, consulting and infusion services to about 167,000 institutional beds as well as to home infusion patients through 56 institutional pharmacies and four regional infusion pharmacies.
